input_and_query_boundary.fields: InventoryStatusUpdateVMCStateBeforeSearchResolver prefers standalone inv_s$comparison_period, then aggregate.comparison_period, then string0 for its comparison/repetition guard. Other consumers read nested aggregate.comparison_period or a comparison_period refer_type. Synchronization/actual current definitions unknown.
input_and_query_boundary.request: Existing DataModelModifier preserves free aggregate fields including comparison_period. SelectInventoryStatusProgram forwards transformed conditions/sorts/groups in read query; later returns data_model=result.data,total_count=result.total_number,date=result.date. No identified period-bound calculation here.
input_and_query_boundary.runtime: setPageData stores date unchanged into ICompareDateOptionRuntime. The captured date-pair provider/calculation is outside this inspected path; no API was invoked.

data_period_marking.source: Normalize resolver acts only when data_model_id/search_dmc exist, aggregate.comparison_period is not string0 and first two data_model entries are arrays. It marks first-array rows __period_index=1, second-array rows __period_index=2, then concatenates those arrays.
data_period_marking.boundary: Expected client data shape only; no response records/schema captured. Does not calculate comparison dates,align rows or produce difference/ratio values.

date_pair_display.source: buildCompareDate destructures date runtime {origin,compare}; if any origin.from/to or compare.from/to missing/falsy, returns[]. Else formats both ranges through external IValueFormatExecutorFeature with $$date_range and emits2entries {value:{from,to},label:formatter.result}.
date_pair_display.date_math: No year/month/week/day arithmetic in this consumer. Dates are supplied, not computed.
date_pair_display.headers: buildPeriodLabelHeaderMeta maps title cell style/font into period label metadata and forces horizontal_align=center. Exact label formatting is external and current concrete metadata unknown.

display_columns_and_preservation.source: grid comparison config skips string0; also returns if ICompareDateOptionRuntime or trx_dt item-meaning prop is undefined. It configures date_prop_id,period labels,title_prop_id for subtotal/pagetotal/total,view_type-preserved props and always-fill props.
display_columns_and_preservation.preserved: getViewTypePreservedPropIds collects $$image_link props and standard refer_type across body/summary/subtotal*/pagetotal/total. getAlwaysFillBodyPropIds collects sequence refer_type props for periods with missing data. Aggregate config also preserves its selected axis prop IDs.
display_columns_and_preservation.unknown: Observed single-axis previous-month query has12headers as recorded above. Source alone does not establish other modes/axes,actual row/cell pairing,missing-period content,zero versus blank values,difference/percentage formulas or print/export shape.

axis_sort_and_matching_keys.axis_criteria: getComparisonPeriodCriteria: fixed uses details_target.props prop IDs; free iterates numeric ordered selected condition keys and emits {prop_id,descending:condition.sort_type===D}.
axis_sort_and_matching_keys.explicit_sort: getSort prefers SearchTemplateModel sort_search.sort if truthy, else widget.attribute.sort, else[]. The comparison config sorts those entries by sort_seq and maps asc_desc===D to descending.
axis_sort_and_matching_keys.extraction: createComparisonValueExtractor reads dynamic DMC datatypes: $$date_record_seq_no -> data_dt$data_no$record_seq_no; $$date_no -> data_dt$data_no; $$code -> value.code; otherwise raw value.
axis_sort_and_matching_keys.boundary: These criteria/extractor are passed to an external comparison engine. Actual row union/alignment,relative-date offset matching,stable identity,sorting precedence between criteria arrays,ties/nulls and collations remain unknown. Do not infer an ordinary GROUPBY or exact original ordering formula from these keys.

clicked_period_drilldown.V56: isComparisonPeriodCell returns true if clicked record has numeric FlexionErp.PERIOD_INDEX_KEY different from PRIMARY_PERIOD_INDEX; otherwise prop_index===1. Constants/renderer binding are external. Common StandardUserAction can replace search date range with runtime compare.from/to and reset comparison to0 for line-view popup.
clicked_period_drilldown.V5_compatible_path: Existing V5 StandardUserAction instead reads owner.prop_id suffix after|; when numeric suffix>1 and date runtime nonempty, uses compare date range. It forwards suffixed values to drilldown builder. This differs from V56 display-layer period handling and is not merged into one current rule.
clicked_period_drilldown.boundary: Click helpers/source only. No original popup/query actions executed; current binding and one/two-period merged-cell behavior unobserved.
